commonIssues.cause: Message code not registered in FND_MESSAGES table
commonIssues.solution: Register message using INSERT INTO FND_NEW_MESSAGES or via OA Framework Personalization

commonIssues.cause: Accessing attribute before it's set or association before initialization
commonIssues.solution: Add null checks before accessing attributes or associations

commonIssues.cause: Association not properly configured in Entity Object XML or FK not set
commonIssues.solution: Verify association in EO XML, ensure FK attribute is set before accessing parent/child

commonIssues.cause: create() or doDML() not properly implemented
commonIssues.solution: Override create() and doDML() following WHO column automation pattern

commonIssues.cause: Missing getTransaction().commit() or validation errors preventing commit
commonIssues.solution: Add commit() in AM method after successful operations, check for validation errors

commonIssues.cause: Sequence not used or sequence cache issue
commonIssues.solution: Use txn.getSequenceValue() in create() method, recreate sequence if needed

commonIssues.cause: WHERE clause too restrictive or parameters not set
commonIssues.solution: Debug with vo.setWhereClause(null) to check all rows, verify bind variable values

commonIssues.cause: Partial target not configured or firePartialChange() not called
commonIssues.solution: Set partialTriggers property on target component, call firePartialChange() after data change
